title: The Rescue That Never Came
hook: Part 5. What happens when Hannibal’s rescue dies before it reaches him?

youtube_description: Part 5 of The Fall of Carthage follows the moment Rome cuts Hannibal off from rescue. Hasdrubal Barca escapes Baecula and races toward Italy, but Rome traps him at the Metaurus before he can join his brother. Then Scipio wins at Ilipa, breaks Carthaginian Spain, becomes consul, and pushes Rome toward a terrifying new strategy: invade Africa. As Roman ships land near Utica and victories follow at the Great Plains, Carthage itself is threatened. Hannibal is not simply leaving Italy by choice. He is recalled home to defend the city that sent him.
